selection_rule: First two case IDs from each existing ordered level/language stratum of the frozen PC-S Planning roster

outcomes.contrasts: P0 against P1 isolates stage separation. P1 through P5 specify the full three-factor experiment. Use matched case/model/seed differences and the factorial difference of differences. Report denominators, levels and languages. Missing or unsupported engine runs remain explicit.

evidence_rule: Bind exact runtime, source, roster and treatment to wire and GPU evidence. Inspect rendered native grammar before counting a schema treatment as applied.
